query: How can I apply for Tamil Nadu Police dog handler positions?
reference_answer:
Tamil Nadu Police Dog Handler Positions:
To apply, visit the Tamil Nadu Uniformed Services Recruitment Board (TNUSRB) website for notifications. Meet the eligibility criteria, fill out the online application, and appear for the written exam and physical tests.
answer: To apply for Tamil Nadu Police dog handler positions, visit the official Tamil Nadu Police website and look for recruitment announcements. Follow the online application process which includes uploading a recent passport size photograph and other required documents. [Document 1]
